acceptedBrowserEvidence.captureScope: Browser screenshots of the selected preview subtree. fullPage:true with clip preserves full mobile candidate content beyond the 844px viewport; these are not first-screen-only mobile images. acceptedBrowserEvidence.initialImages: Seven initial captures are retained only as closed-finding evidence; final regression claims refer to the 50 final images, including six grayscale simulations.
acceptedBrowserEvidence.readingTimeClaim: No timed human study or new 20-second comprehension claim. The sealed 60–118 word count is a design heuristic; scrolling time is not measured.

acceptedAccessibilityEvidence.method: DOM, real Chromium keyboard, WCAG relative luminance with composited ancestor backgrounds and both gradient stops. Text-only semantic meaning reviewed separately. No axe installation or screen-reader/human study claimed.

sharedCandidateHeadReview.fontPolicy: Shared existing Inter/system fallback stack in globals.css. No repository font binaries or next/font import are part of the candidate UI; V2 stylesheet has no @font-face, @import or url(). Physical font rasterization in a different OS/browser is not asserted identical.
sharedCandidateHeadReview.v2PropsIsolation: RegimeV2Surface accepts only RegimeV2View, generated from the exact fixture output and locale; RegimeV2Disclosure receives server children/className. The four excluded shared deltas do not supply V2 interpretation, evidence links, IDs, source targets, methodology, layout classes or dimensions.
sharedCandidateHeadReview.tailwindScope: Tailwind and PostCSS definitions are unchanged. Candidate selection may alter the full-site generated CSS/module inventory by excluding unrelated routes; this report establishes unchanged source definitions and V2 scoped styles, not a fresh full-site compiled-asset byte comparison.

limitations: The selected candidate still requires its own typecheck/build/tests and production HTTP guard validation; those release gates are recorded by the root verification work.
Archived QA measurements and screenshots are reused only after exact hash preservation; this is not a newly executed visual or accessibility test.
V1 public authority, shadow OFF, historical R2-only replay and no point-in-time OOS/live-complete capture claim remain unchanged.
